exempt.why: Grounding, minting and the validation gates read unverified, held and superseded rows on purpose: they are what makes a row verified (R2a and R2b own them).
The mint and its heal read the rows they are minting or healing, verified or not.
Intake, quarantine and the change sweep read staged, unverified and archived items on purpose.
Batch export and apply read the items a session-authored batch is about, whatever their state.
Question generation and signpost scoring read the items they were asked about.
The flywheel passes (connect, tag, discovery, corpus) read the corpus they are connecting, as pipeline stages.
The connect stage's pattern step reads the pattern values it wrote earlier, stale and superseded ones included, to supersede or retire them; it is the writer of those rows, not a reader of them.
The pattern step's signposts: it reads the inference records it wrote for its own patterns (any admissibility, to score the signpost of a pattern that has since gone), as their writer.
Source classification and change detection read the items of a source to classify and compare them.
Entity linking reads the items it links.
Entity linking reads the items it links.
Tag adoption reads the items a tag is adopted onto.

The carbon step of the propagate stage writes the derived values it computes and retires the one each replaces; it reads the current values only through core/derived/carbon.ts, which takes derived_values_admissible.
Re-opening a question reads the item the question was about.
Syncs one named item's deadline column from its events; the events it reads exclude a suppressed claim's.
Reads one named item's last-regenerated date for extraction; the claims it reads exclude a suppressed claim.
The connect stage's backlog scan heals items quarantined by a prior extractor's bogus compliance_deadline and re-validates their required slots.
The admin console reads and corrects any item in any state.
The health surface counts items by state.
A recalculation notice shows the value that was replaced beside the one that replaced it: it reads superseded rows on purpose.
The admin corrections API lists an item's corrections and finds the ones whose claim is gone: it reads the claims of any item in any state to do it.
